CREATE TABLE "public"."delivery_zones" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "baseFeeMinor" int8 NOT NULL,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'ILS' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_zone_terms_304e5d3f" CHECK ("baseFeeMinor" >= 0 AND "revision" > 0 AND "currency" IN ('ILS','USD','EUR','JOD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_access_events" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" json NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_imports" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "result" json,
  "rows" json NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_invitations" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "acceptedById" text,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "issuedById" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "permissions" json NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "merchant_invitation_state_866e5749" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER','EMPLOYEE') AND NOT ("acceptedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "revokedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND (("acceptedAt" IS NULL AND "acceptedById" IS NULL) OR ("acceptedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "acceptedById" IS NOT NULL)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_memberships" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "permissions" json NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "merchant_membership_state_8d4514eb" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER','EMPLOYEE') AND "status" IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_parcel_requests" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "parcelRevision" int4 NOT NULL,
  "previous" json NOT NULL,
  "proposed" json NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "requestedBy" text NOT NULL,
  "reviewReason" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedBy" text,
  "shipmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "merchant_parcel_request_state_9f2bdd06" CHECK ("kind" IN ('AMEND','CANCEL') AND (("status" = 'REQUESTED' AND "reviewedBy" IS NULL AND "reviewedAt" IS NULL) OR ("status" IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND "reviewedBy" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewedAt" IS NOT NULL)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_plans" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'ILS' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "merchant_plan_terms_eae8fe0e" CHECK ("revision" > 0 AND "currency" IN ('ILS','USD','EUR','JOD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."merchant_settlement_requests" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'ILS' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "requestedBy" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "merchant_settlement_request_state_8bcfc360" CHECK ("status" IN ('REQUESTED','REVIEWED') AND "currency" IN ('ILS','USD','EUR','JOD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pickup_parcels" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "pickupId" text NOT NULL,
  "receipt" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "receiptNotes" text,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz,
  "receivedBy" text,
  "shipmentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pickup_parcel_receipt_6cdef2b2" CHECK ("receipt" IN ('PENDING','RECEIVED','MISSING','DISCREPANT') AND ("receipt" = 'PENDING' OR ("receivedBy" IS NOT NULL AND "receivedAt" IS NOT NULL)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pickup_requests" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "confirmedFrom" timestamptz,
  "confirmedTo" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "merchantId" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "pickupAddress" text NOT NULL,
  "preferredFrom" timestamptz,
  "preferredTo" timestamptz,
  "proposedFrom" timestamptz,
  "proposedTo" timestamptz,
  "reviewedBy" text,
  "revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" text,
  "workerId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pickup_confirmed_window_50678bdd" CHECK (("confirmedFrom" IS NULL AND "confirmedTo" IS NULL) OR ("confirmedFrom" IS NOT NULL AND "confirmedTo" IS NOT NULL AND "confirmedTo" > "confirmedFrom")),
  CONSTRAINT "pickup_coordinates_6e73a6d3" CHECK (("latitude" IS NULL AND "longitude" IS NULL) OR ("latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)),
  CONSTRAINT "pickup_preferred_window_68f78b5a" CHECK (("preferredFrom" IS NULL AND "preferredTo" IS NULL) OR ("preferredFrom" IS NOT NULL AND "preferredTo" IS NOT NULL AND "preferredTo" > "preferredFrom")),
  CONSTRAINT "pickup_request_state_3d349cea" CHECK ("method" IN ('COMPANY_PICKUP','WAREHOUSE_DROPOFF') AND "status" IN ('REQUESTED','PROPOSED','CONFIRMED','RECEIVED','CANCELLED') AND "revision" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."plan_zone_tariffs" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "discountMinor" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "feeMinor" int8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "promotionDiscountMinor" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "promotionLabel" text,
  "zoneId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "plan_zone_tariff_amounts_e0c86530" CHECK ("feeMinor" >= 0 AND "discountMinor" >= 0 AND "promotionDiscountMinor" >= 0 AND "feeMinor" >= "discountMinor"+"promotionDiscountMinor" AND ("promotionDiscountMinor" = 0 OR ("promotionLabel" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("promotionLabel")) > 0)))
)
